_note: Practice scenarios. Each fills in the Plan (reader, goal, key facts, deadline) only — the learner writes every word. focus = the C this scenario works hardest. Levels unlock after finishing 2 at the level below.

scenarios.title: The broken heater
scenarios.situation: Your apartment's heater stopped working on Monday, Oct 26. It's getting cold at night. Ask your property manager to send a repair person.
scenarios.goal: Get the heater fixed this week

scenarios.title: Calling out sick
scenarios.situation: You woke up with a fever and can't work your shift on Wednesday, Oct 28. Let your manager know and say who can cover your 2 p.m. customer call.
scenarios.goal: Let my manager know I'm out today and who's covering
scenarios.facts: Dana can take the 2 p.m. call

scenarios.title: Thank you after an interview
scenarios.situation: You interviewed on Tuesday, Nov 10 for an Office Assistant job at Sunrise Dental. Thank the office manager and mention one topic you talked about.
scenarios.goal: Thank her and remind her I'm interested

scenarios.title: Still waiting on a quote
scenarios.situation: On Tuesday, Nov 3, you emailed a print shop for a price on 200 flyers. Nobody has answered. Follow up politely and say when you need the price.
scenarios.goal: Get the flyer price in time to order

scenarios.title: Ask for a short meeting
scenarios.situation: Your work schedule changed and now clashes with your evening class. Ask your manager for a 20-minute meeting to talk about it.
scenarios.goal: Get a 20-minute meeting about my schedule

scenarios.title: The break room fridge
scenarios.situation: Starting Friday, Nov 13, the office manager will clear out the break room fridge every Friday at 4 p.m. Write a short memo to all staff. Put the bottom line first.
scenarios.goal: Everyone takes their food home by Friday at 4 p.m.
scenarios.facts:
every Friday at 4 p.m.
Friday, Nov 13

scenarios.title: Asking for more time
scenarios.situation: Your essay for English 101 is due Thursday, Nov 12, but you were out sick for three days. Ask your professor for a two-day extension.
scenarios.goal: Get a two-day extension on the essay

scenarios.title: The damaged order
scenarios.situation: The desk you ordered (order #48213) arrived on Oct 26 with a cracked top. You want a replacement, or your $289 back.
scenarios.goal: Get a replacement desk or a refund

scenarios.title: Moving the weekly meeting
scenarios.situation: Starting the week of Monday, Nov 9, the team meeting moves from Monday at 9 a.m. to Thursday at 10 a.m. in Conference Room B. Tell the team.
scenarios.goal: Everyone knows the new day, time, and room

scenarios.title: Giving two weeks' notice
scenarios.situation: You got a new job. Tell your manager you're leaving, with Friday, Nov 20 as your last day. Thank them and offer to help train your replacement.

scenarios.title: Website project update
scenarios.situation: You're redoing the shop's website. The menu page is done, the photos are half done, and the order form is late because the payment company is slow. Write a progress report for the owner.
scenarios.goal: The owner knows what's done, what's next, and what's late
scenarios.facts:
menu page
order form
Monday, Nov 23

scenarios.title: Apologizing for late rent
scenarios.situation: Your October rent was 5 days late because you mixed up the due date. Apologize to your landlord, own it, and say how you'll make sure it doesn't happen again.
scenarios.goal: Apologize and keep a good relationship with my landlord

scenarios.title: Cover letter: first office job
scenarios.situation: After three years in retail, you're applying to be an Office Coordinator at Valley Clinic. Use one real story about organizing the stockroom schedule.
scenarios.goal: Get an interview for the Office Coordinator job
scenarios.facts:
Office Coordinator
Valley Clinic
three years

scenarios.title: Writing up a slip-and-fall
scenarios.situation: A customer slipped near the front door at 3:15 p.m. on Tuesday, Oct 27, after a spill. They weren't hurt. Write the incident report for your manager.
scenarios.goal: A clear, factual record of what happened and what to fix

scenarios.title: A refund for a broken blender
scenarios.situation: Your $89.99 blender, order #5521, arrived cracked on Monday, Nov 2. Write to the company asking for a refund. Make your point, give the reasons, and say what you want and by when.

scenarios.title: First job: gym front desk
scenarios.situation: You're applying for a front desk job at Valley Fitness. You haven't had a paid job yet, but you ran the sign-in table for your school's 5K and volunteer at the library. Tell one short story that shows you'd be good with members.
